ei.title: 2번: A Lesson from the Irish Famine
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: In the 1800s, the people of Ireland used potatoes as their basic food source. Unfortunately, everyone was growing the same type of potato, which meant the crops all had the same genes. The farmers did not realize the danger in this. In the 1840s, a new potato disease struck. The genetically identical potatoes all lacked the ability to fight the disease, so they all rotted. Because people were dependent mainly on potatoes for their food, Ireland suffered a famine in which one in eight people died during the following years. If people had grown many types of potatoes, they could have identified resistant ones and grown more of them, making the famine less serious. Despite knowing this, many countries today take the same risk with their crops.

questions.passage: In the 1800s, the people of Ireland ①<u>used</u> potatoes as their basic food source. Unfortunately, everyone was growing the same type of potato, which meant the crops all had the same genes. The farmers did not realize the danger in this. In the 1840s, a new potato disease ②<u>struck</u>. The genetically identical potatoes all lacked the ability to fight the disease, so they all rotted. Because people were dependent mainly on potatoes for their food, Ireland suffered a famine in which one in eight people died during the following years. If people had grown many types of potatoes, they could have identified resistant ones and grown more of them, ③<u>make</u> the famine less serious. Despite knowing this, many countries today ④<u>take</u> the same risk with their crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: make → making (콤마 뒤에서 앞 내용을 부연하는 분사구문이므로 현재분사 making)
det.analysis:
① used: 'the people of Ireland used potatoes' 과거의 일을 나타내는 과거동사 — 적절

② struck: 'a new potato disease struck' 병이 '덮쳤다'는 과거동사 — 적절

③ make: '..., grown more of them, make the famine less serious'? 콤마 뒤에서 '그래서 (결과적으로) ~하게 만들며'라고 앞 문장을 부연하려면 접속사와 주어 없이 동사를 -ing로 바꾼 분사구문 making이 와야 해요. 그냥 동사원형 make는 주어도 접속사도 없어 문장에 걸리지 않으므로 틀려요 ←정답

④ take: 'many countries today take the same risk' 현재의 일반적 사실을 나타내는 현재동사 — 적절
det.tip: 콤마 뒤에서 앞 내용을 부연하면 분사구문 → 동사원형(make)이 아니라 making

questions.passage: In the 1800s, the people of Ireland used potatoes as their basic food source. ①<u>Unfortunately</u>, everyone was growing the same type of potato, which meant the crops all had the same genes. The farmers did not realize the danger in this. In the 1840s, a new potato disease struck. The ②<u>genetic</u> identical potatoes all lacked the ability to fight the disease, so they all rotted. Because people were ③<u>dependent</u> mainly on potatoes for their food, Ireland suffered a famine in which one in eight people died during the following years. If people had grown many types of potatoes, they could have identified resistant ones and grown more of them, making the famine less serious. Despite ④<u>knowing</u> this, many countries today take the same risk with their crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: genetic → genetically (형용사 identical을 꾸미므로 부사 genetically)
det.analysis:
① Unfortunately: '불행하게도'라는 뜻으로 문장 전체를 꾸미는 부사 — 적절

② genetic: 'The genetic identical potatoes'? 뒤의 형용사 identical(동일한)을 꾸며 '유전적으로 동일한'이라는 뜻을 만들려면 형용사가 아니라 부사 genetically가 와야 해요. 형용사 genetic은 형용사를 꾸밀 수 없으므로 틀려요 ←정답

③ dependent: 'people were dependent mainly on potatoes'에서 be동사 뒤의 형용사 보어 — 적절

④ knowing: 'Despite knowing this'에서 전치사 Despite(~에도 불구하고) 뒤에는 명사 역할을 하는 동명사가 와야 하므로 knowing — 적절
det.tip: 형용사(identical)를 꾸미는 것은 부사 → genetically identical

Because people were dependent mainly on potatoes for their food, Ireland suffered a famine ③<u>which</u> one in eight people died during the following years. If people had grown many types of potatoes, they could have identified resistant ones and grown more of them, making the famine less serious. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: which → in which (뒤 문장이 완전하고 '기근 속에서' 죽었다는 뜻이므로 전치사+관계대명사 in which)
det.analysis:
① realize: 'The farmers did not realize the danger' 조동사 did 뒤의 동사원형 realize — 적절

② identical: 'The genetically identical potatoes'에서 명사 potatoes를 앞에서 꾸미는 형용사 — 적절

③ which: 'a famine which one in eight people died during the following years'? 뒤 문장(one in eight people died ~)이 주어·동사를 다 갖춘 완전한 문장이에요. '그 기근 속에서(in the famine)' 죽었다는 뜻이라 관계대명사 which 앞에 전치사 in이 필요해요. 즉 in which(= 그 안에서)가 맞으므로 which만 쓰면 틀려요 ←정답

④ take: 'many countries today take the same risk' 현재의 일반적 사실을 나타내는 현재동사 — 적절
det.tip: 뒤 문장이 완전 + '~속에서'라는 뜻 → 전치사+관계대명사 in which

questions.passage: In the 1800s, the people of Ireland used potatoes as their basic food source. Unfortunately, everyone was growing the same type of potato, which meant the crops all had the same genes. The farmers did not realize the danger in this. In the 1840s, a new potato disease struck. The genetically identical potatoes all lacked the ability to fight the disease, so they all ①<u>flourished</u>. Because people were dependent mainly on potatoes for their food, Ireland ②<u>suffered</u> a famine in which one in eight people died during the following years. If people had grown many types of potatoes, they could have identified ③<u>resistant</u> ones and grown more of them, making the famine less serious. Despite knowing this, many countries today take the same ④<u>risk</u> with their crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: flourished → rotted (병과 싸울 능력이 없었으니 감자는 번성한 게 아니라 모두 '썩었다')
det.analysis:
① flourished: '병과 싸울 능력이 없어서 감자가 모두 flourished(번성했다)'? 능력이 없었으면 병에 져서 죽거나 '썩었을(rotted)' 거예요. 번성했다는 것은 정반대이므로 부적절 ←정답

② suffered: '아일랜드가 기근을 겪었다(suffered a famine)' — 재앙을 겪었다는 뜻으로 적절

③ resistant: '저항력 있는(resistant) 품종을 찾아 더 길렀다면' — 병을 견디는 품종을 찾는다는 흐름으로 적절

④ risk: '오늘날에도 같은 위험(risk)을 감수한다' — 과거의 실수를 되풀이한다는 흐름으로 적절
det.tip: 병과 싸울 능력이 없었다 → 감자는 rotted(썩었다). flourished(번성했다)는 반대

questions.passage: In the 1800s, the people of Ireland used potatoes as their basic food source. ①<u>Unfortunately</u>, everyone was growing the same type of potato, which meant the crops all had the same genes. The farmers did not realize the danger in this. In the 1840s, a new potato disease struck. The genetically ②<u>unique</u> potatoes all lacked the ability to fight the disease, so they all rotted. Because people were dependent mainly on potatoes for their food, Ireland ③<u>suffered</u> a famine in which one in eight people died during the following years. If people had grown many types of potatoes, they could have identified resistant ones and grown more of them, making the famine less serious. Despite knowing this, many countries today take the same ④<u>risk</u> with their crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: unique → identical (같은 품종만 길러 유전자가 '동일'했기에 다 함께 병에 졌다)
det.analysis:
① Unfortunately: '불행하게도' 모두가 같은 품종을 길렀다 — 그것이 재앙으로 이어졌으므로 적절

② unique: 'The genetically unique potatoes all lacked the ability to fight the disease, so they all rotted'? 감자가 유전적으로 '고유했다(unique=제각각 달랐다)'면 다 함께 병에 지지도, 다 같이 썩지도 않았을 거예요. 모두 같은 품종이라 유전자가 '동일했기(identical)' 때문에 다 함께 썩었으므로 unique는 부적절 ←정답

③ suffered: '아일랜드가 기근을 겪었다' — 적절

④ risk: '오늘날에도 같은 위험을 감수한다' — 적절
det.tip: 다 함께 병에 져서 썩음 → 유전자가 identical(동일). unique(제각각 다른)는 반대

questions.passage: In the 1800s, the people of Ireland used potatoes as their basic food source. Unfortunately, everyone was growing the same type of potato, which meant the crops all had the same genes. The farmers did not realize the danger in this. In the 1840s, a new potato disease struck. The genetically identical potatoes all lacked the ability to __________, so they all rotted. Because people were dependent mainly on potatoes for their food, Ireland suffered a famine in which one in eight people died during the following years. If people had grown many types of potatoes, they could have identified resistant ones and grown more of them, making the famine less serious. Despite knowing this, many countries today take the same risk with their crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: spread more widely=더 널리 퍼지다 / grow much taller=훨씬 더 크게 자라다 / change their shape=모양을 바꾸다 / fight the disease=병과 싸우다
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장은 'The genetically identical potatoes all lacked the ability to ___, so they all rotted(유전적으로 동일한 감자들은 ___할 능력이 없어서 모두 썩었다)'예요. 바로 앞에 새로운 병(disease)이 덮쳤다는 내용이 나와요.

① spread more widely(더 널리 퍼지다): 감자가 스스로 퍼진다는 것은 문맥과 무관

② grow much taller(훨씬 크게 자라다): 키가 크는 능력은 썩는 것과 연결되지 않음

③ change their shape(모양을 바꾸다): 모양 변화는 병·썩음과 무관

④ fight the disease(병과 싸우다): 병과 싸울 능력이 없어서 모두 썩었다는 흐름과 정확히 일치 ←정답
det.tip: 새 병이 덮침 + 다 썩음 → 병과 싸울(fight the disease) 능력이 없었음

questions.passage: In the 1800s, the people of Ireland used potatoes as their basic food source. Unfortunately, everyone was growing the same type of potato, which meant the crops all had the same genes. The farmers did not realize the danger in this. In the 1840s, a new potato disease struck. The genetically identical potatoes all lacked the ability to fight the disease, so they all rotted. Because people were dependent mainly on potatoes for their food, Ireland suffered a famine in which one in eight people died during the following years. If people had grown many types of potatoes, they could have identified __________ and grown more of them, making the famine less serious. Despite knowing this, many countries today take the same risk with their crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: resistant ones=저항력 있는 품종들 / foreign markets=해외 시장 / higher prices=더 높은 가격 / older methods=더 오래된 방법
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장은 'they could have identified ___ and grown more of them, making the famine less serious(그들은 ___를 찾아내 더 많이 길러 기근을 덜 심각하게 만들 수 있었을 것이다)'예요. 여러 품종을 길렀다면 그중 무엇을 골라 길렀을지 생각해요.

① resistant ones(저항력 있는 품종들): 병을 견디는 품종을 골라 더 기르면 기근이 덜 심각해진다는 흐름과 일치 ←정답

② foreign markets(해외 시장): 시장을 '길렀다'는 것은 말이 안 되고 문맥 무관

③ higher prices(더 높은 가격): 가격을 기른다는 것도 어색하고 무관

④ older methods(더 오래된 방법): 방법을 기른다는 것도 문맥과 안 맞음
det.tip: 여러 품종 중 병을 견디는 것을 골라 기름 → resistant ones(저항력 있는 품종들)

questions.passage: In the 1800s, the people of Ireland used potatoes as their basic food source. Unfortunately, everyone was growing the same type of potato, which meant the crops all had the same genes. The farmers did not realize the danger in this. In the 1840s, a new potato disease struck. The genetically identical potatoes all lacked the ability to fight the disease, so they all rotted. Because people were dependent mainly on potatoes for their food, Ireland suffered a famine in which one in eight people died during the following years. If people had grown many types of potatoes, they could have identified resistant ones and grown more of them, making the famine less serious. Despite knowing this, many countries today take the same risk with their crops.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 본문 'In the 1840s, a new potato disease struck. The genetically identical potatoes all lacked the ability to fight the disease, so they all rotted'를 바꿔 말한 ③이 일치
det.analysis:
① 다양한 품종을 골고루 재배: 본문은 모두가 '같은 품종(the same type)'을 길렀다고 하므로 반대

② 위험을 미리 알고 대비: 본문 'The farmers did not realize the danger(농부들은 그 위험을 깨닫지 못했다)'와 반대

③ 1840년대 병으로 유전적으로 같은 감자들이 모두 썩음: 본문의 '1840년대에 병이 덮쳤고, 유전적으로 동일한 감자들이 병과 싸울 능력이 없어 모두 썩었다'와 일치 ←정답

④ 그해에 곧바로 끝나 피해 없음: 본문은 '이후 여러 해(following years)' 동안 여덟 명 중 한 명이 죽었다고 하므로 반대
det.tip: 1840년대 병 + 동일 유전자라 못 싸움 + 모두 썩음 = ③

ch: 아일랜드 사람들은 다양한 품종의 감자를 골고루 재배했다.
농부들은 획일적 재배의 위험을 미리 알고 대비했다.
1840년대에 발생한 병으로 유전적으로 같은 감자들이 모두 썩었다.
기근은 발생한 그해에 곧바로 끝나 피해가 없었다.

questions.passage: In the 1800s, the people of Ireland used potatoes as their basic food source. Unfortunately, everyone was growing the same type of potato, which meant the crops all had the same genes. The farmers did not realize the danger in this. In the 1840s, a new potato disease struck. The genetically identical potatoes all lacked the ability to fight the disease, so they all rotted. Because people were dependent mainly on potatoes for their food, Ireland suffered a famine in which one in eight people died during the following years. If people had grown many types of potatoes, they could have identified resistant ones and grown more of them, making the famine less serious. Despite knowing this, many countries today take the same risk with their crops.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 본문은 'one in eight people died(여덟 명 중 한 명이 죽었다)'라고 했지 '절반'이 아니므로 ④가 불일치
det.analysis:
① 감자가 기본 식량: 본문 'used potatoes as their basic food source'와 일치

② 숨은 위험을 못 알아챔: 본문 'did not realize the danger in this'와 일치

③ 감자 의존 때문에 기근을 겪음: 본문 'Because people were dependent mainly on potatoes ~, Ireland suffered a famine'과 일치

④ 전체 인구의 절반이 사망: 본문은 '여덟 명 중 한 명(one in eight people)'이 죽었다고 했어요. '절반(1/2)'은 실제 비율을 부풀린 것이라 사실과 다르므로 불일치 ←정답
det.tip: one in eight(여덟 명 중 한 명) ≠ 절반. ④가 숫자를 왜곡

ch: 감자는 당시 아일랜드 사람들의 기본 식량이었다.
농부들은 같은 품종만 기르는 데 숨은 위험을 알아채지 못했다.
감자에 대한 의존 때문에 아일랜드는 기근을 겪었다.
아일랜드 기근으로 전체 인구의 절반이 목숨을 잃었다.

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 본문 'Because people were dependent mainly on potatoes for their food'를 바꿔 말한 ①이 일치
det.analysis:
① 주로 감자에 의존해 식량을 얻음: 본문 'people were dependent mainly on potatoes for their food(사람들이 주로 감자에 의존했다)'와 일치 ←정답

② 해마다 다른 품종으로 바꿔 심음: 본문은 모두가 '같은 품종'을 길렀다고 하므로 반대

③ 병이 발생 직후 완전히 사라짐: 본문에 병이 사라졌다는 언급이 없고, 오히려 여러 해 동안 피해가 이어졌으므로 반대

④ 오늘날 다양화해 위험을 없앰: 본문은 '많은 나라가 여전히 같은 위험을 감수한다(take the same risk)'고 하므로 반대
det.tip: dependent mainly on potatoes = 주로 감자에 의존 → ①

ch: 아일랜드 사람들은 주로 감자에 의존해 식량을 얻었다.
농부들은 해마다 다른 품종으로 감자를 바꿔 심었다.
감자 병은 발생 직후 완전히 사라졌다.
오늘날 여러 나라는 작물을 다양화해 위험을 없앴다.
